purpose: A wallpaper for Mack's phone: a snapshot of a woman from the cast (a stand-in for Megumi for now). Portrait, the home screen's clock and apps sit over the dark upper part.

items.style: candid 35mm film snapshot, late 1980s Japan, city pop mood, natural light, soft film grain, a photograph taken by someone who loves her
items.subject: a woman in her twenties on the open deck of a harbour ferry at dusk, wind in her dark hair, a light trench coat, turning to look back at the camera with a small unguarded smile, the bay and the distant city lights behind her, a deep blue evening sky above
items.composition: tall vertical composition, the woman in the lower half of the frame, the upper third of the frame dark, open and uncluttered
